sqliteSql: SELECT store_id,gross_cents-discount_cents-refund_cents AS net_cents,gross_cents-discount_cents-refund_cents-cost_after_returns_cents AS profit_cents,100.0*(gross_cents-discount_cents-refund_cents)/NULLIF(target_cents,0) AS target_pct FROM shop_totals ORDER BY store_id
